frequency_question: How often do riparian states successfully renew or renegotiate a major long-term water-sharing treaty prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Includes binding international water treaties with fixed expiration terms requiring renegotiation. Excludes non-binding declarations or treaties without expiration clauses.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and modifications (Ongoing 50+ year framework)
Columbia River Treaty regime reviews and operational updates
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase agreements

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named core benchmark cases; broader global class of bilateral water treaty renewals estimated at approximately 10 major instances.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sub-national river basins where legal frameworks are weaker.
skeleton: Major transboundary water treaties reaching end-of-term milestones where institutional inertia and baseline hydrological interdependence strongly incentivize continuity.
multiplier: Historically, essential resource interdependence drives successful renewal in roughly 8 out of 10 comparable bilateral frameworks.
validity_reason: International water law norms and hydro-diplomacy frameworks evolve slowly over multi-decade horizons.
